trigger: Automated Codex review of pull request shifosss/frontier-trading-agent#2, four P2 findings on commit 1f6ef6dc

changes.reason: The reused roots under discovery/profiles/raw are published under the shared sec-source.lock.sqlite, which the audit did not guard. Both source writer locks are now required, held read-only for the whole run, and probed by preflight.
A drifted definition with a malformed amendment entry raised KeyError. A frozen-SHA mismatch now returns immediately without parsing the untrusted definition.

A run created a new attempt regardless of earlier ones. A repeat of the same definition is now refused (a rerun needs a new amendment), and unfinished or unreadable attempts must be listed as reconciled before a new attempt.
The qualification events file also holds S, Q and u values. Only accession, strategy_source_status and entry_session now survive parsing, and the scope says exactly that.

unchanged: Denominators, window, candidate rules, clock, classification, outputs, bounds and verdict thresholds.
